item.title: BME Graduate Programs Information Webinar
item.description: Date: Thursday, October 29, 2026 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM - The Biomedical Engineering Graduate Department would like to invite you to learn about the many graduate school opportunities in Biomedical Engineering! Join us for an information session on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 10am EDT to learn more about the graduate degrees offered, specific research areas our department specializes in, and the application process. We also welcome any questions you may have during the event. For more…

item.title: National First-Generation Student Week | November 2nd-6th, 2026
item.description: The Office of Inclusive Excellence (O.I.E.) is happy to announce this year’s National First-Gen Week events being held Monday, November 02 through Friday, November 06! This week is about campus events that empower first-generation students to learn about what resources are available as well as connecting with fellow first-generation students, faculty, and staff!

item.title: 2027 McKinney Writing Contest
item.description: The 2027 McKinney Writing Contest is open from November 1, 2025 through March 9, 2026. Submit in any or all of the following categories: Academic Essay (undergraduate and graduate division); Fiction, Creative Nonfiction, or Drama; Poetry; or Language & Image. First prize $300; 2nd prize $175; and 3rd prize $75. Submit: https://hass.rpi.edu/mckinney. Submit in fall for December graduates. Questions? McKinney@rpi.edu

item.description: Date: Monday, October 26, 2026 - Fri , October 30, 2026 (all day) - Phalanx was founded in 1912 to recognize Rensselaer students who distinguish themselves in the areas of Leadership, Service, and Devotion to the Alma Mater. Please consider nominating yourself or your peers for Phalanx membership, or staff members who have increased the welfare of the Institute for Honorary Phalanx Membership! item.title: Beneath the Hudson
item.description: Friday / October 30, 2026 at 3:00 pm EMPAC at RPI transforms local history into a one-night-only immersive haunted ship adventure in Troy, Friday OCT 30. Solve the mystery, trick-or-treat through the building, craft with FlagSSS Day Collective, catch a Halloween movie, live performances, costume contest, and so much more! After the kids head home, the lights go down for DJ and dancing. Screening, Installation An Immersive Halloween Adventure at EMPAC

item.title: RPI Grad Women’s Club Meet & Greet
item.description: Date: Thursday, October 29, 2026 5:00 PM - 6:30 PM - RPI Grad Women’s Club is hosting a Meet & Greet on Thursday, October 29, from 5:00 to 6:30 PM at CBIS Bruggeman Conference room, and they would love for you to join them. It’s a relaxed way to meet fellow graduate students, faculty, and staff from across all departments, connect with women in your field and beyond, and learn more about our club. Cookies and coffee will be provided, along with some fun activities.

item.title: Drug-Free Schools and Campus Regulations Annual Notification
item.description: The health and safety of our RPI community is of utmost importance. In furtherance of our efforts to enhance the wellbeing of our students, staff, and faculty, and in compliance with the Drug-Free Schools and Communities Act (DFSCA), we have reviewed and updated the Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute’s Drug-Free Schools and Campus Regulations Annual Notification.
